rules.accepted_credit_types: CE from an accredited CE provider, of a type sufficient to meet the standard of care for the pharmacist's practice setting
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE for the first renewal after licensure by examination.
rules.alternatives: Deemed compliant: active-duty military serving honorably during the renewal period; nonresident pharmacists actively licensed in their home state who do not practice in Iowa.

topics.who: Pharmacists who examine, attend, counsel or treat minors or dependent adults: child and/or dependent adult abuse identification and reporting training (child abuse core curriculum every 3 years per Iowa Code 232.69)

rules.notes: Licenses expire June 30, two years after initial licensure. Rules moved from 657 IAC to 481 IAC ch. 551 (effective after ARRC delay lifted Aug 11, 2025).
